name: Open WebUI | Self-Hosted AI Chat (ChatGPT Alternative)
description: Open WebUI: self-hosted ChatGPT-style chat for OpenAI, Claude or any OpenAI API. Admin set at deploy, tested updates.

WEBUI_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Login email for the admin account, created on the first boot. Change it later in Admin Panel → Users.

WEBUI_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the admin account. Only read on the first boot; change it later under Settings → Account.

WEBUI_SECRET_KEY.description: Signs logins and encrypts saved API keys. Changing it signs everyone out.

WEBUI_URL.description: Public URL of the app, used in links and for sign-in providers. Set it to your own domain if you add one.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. An OpenAI API key to connect on the first boot. You can add OpenAI, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible API later in Admin Panel → Settings → Connections.
